title: Keewano custom event definitions
description: One file, every event. Position in `events` is the event's wire id: the first is 2500, the next 2501, and so on. Reordering or removing an entry renumbers every entry after it.

events.description: The events, in declaration order. Append to the end; the order is the numbering.

eventName.description: Event name. PascalCase ASCII identifier; capped at 128 characters so the wire varint length stays small and a pathological input cannot dominate the gzip pass.

eventValueType.description: Payload type, spelled as the generator's help prints it: none, string, uint, bool, timestamp, ushortvec2, price_usd_cent.
